gates_note: gates v2 with no limit tighter than the score of the drawing itself (a perfect net) with 10% of room, and a seed that puts every pixel on the right side at every counted size passing the error-amount rules; the owner decided it on 2026-11-17 after the first scores of this lane, on the evidence that some limits measured the sampling and not the net

teacher.what: every drawn character as one set; a character's nearest drawing is looked for among all of them

limits_eased_what: limits applied to a net in the bundle at the perfect drawing's own score with 10% of room, where that is looser than the declared limit; each is listed with the net (rule, declared, perfect, applied)
selection: a net ships when seed 0 and seed 1 both pass the declared gates, the seed with the lower mean of the mean error at 8x16, 16x32 and 48x96; a group that fails is trained once more as two nets of half its characters each; a half that fails is left out and its characters stay untrained; nothing that failed ships
trainer: train/split_expert.py train --mode repertoire --partition contiguous, width 64, 120000 steps, seeds 0,1, teacher grid 256
